text: /** * Error: nested "error" object for extensibility. */ public static function error( string $code, string $message, int $status = 400, mixed $details = null ): never { $error = ['code' => $code, 'message' => $message]; if ($details !== null) { $error['details'] = $details; } self::emit(['ok' => false, 'error' => $error], $status); }
